request.title: Requirements Markdown exporter emits forbidden em-dash separators
request.summary: Severity low. Supported generateDocument output uses U+2014 in Technical-Requirements title separators, violating this workspace no-em-dash rule. Opus F-08 found 139 occurrences in the newly exported document, including the two corrected tape TR sections. Existing wiki backup has the same count. Expected: supported export should honor the required ASCII separator convention without hand-editing generated output. This is an incidental exporter formatting defect, not an emulator defect.
request.evidence: Verified U+2014 count=139; source review docs/receipts/hv/20261009T141130-0500-approved-tape-ac-opus/verdict.json finding F-08. Approval delta and native source unchanged.
reproductionHints: Generate all requirements via the supported workflow; count U+2014 in Technical-Requirements.md. Acceptance: zero em/en dashes in generated separators; preserve requirement content and AC; add generator regression tests.
